# pip-audit allowlist, read by the python-deps-scan CI job.
#
# One vulnerability ID (PYSEC-... or CVE-...) per line, with a comment above
# it explaining why it's accepted. Blank lines and lines starting with # are
# ignored.
#
# pip-audit's advisory sources (PyPI advisory DB / OSV) do not carry a
# consistent CVSS severity for every Python advisory, so unlike the Rust and
# container gates this one cannot filter by severity threshold directly: it
# fails on ANY known vulnerability by default. That is the deliberately
# stricter reading of "fail on critical and high" where the spec is silent —
# anything lower-severity that needs to pass CI must be added here explicitly
# with a reason, rather than silently let through by a threshold cargo-audit
# and Trivy can express but pip-audit cannot.
